solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Public notice in which president put down police

parts.note: to lay something is to put it down
the Old Bill is British slang for the police

explanation.surface: A notice tells the public how the president suppressed the police.
explanation.walkthrough: THE BILL (or Old Bill) is British slang for the police.
explanation.definitionFit: A poster announcing a theatrical performance is a notice put up for the public to read.

clue.text: Stealing makes relationship entertaining

parts.note: pi is the ratio, a fixed relationship, of a circle's circumference to its diameter
racy means lively and entertaining

explanation.surface: Theft gives a love affair some excitement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'relationship' wants to be a romance; it is the mathematical ratio pi.
explanation.definitionFit: Robbery at sea, or copying protected work illegally, is a form of theft.

clue.text: Copper has the last word about judgment

indicators.note: the outer piece is placed about the other

parts.note: amen is the last word of a prayer
Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

explanation.surface: A police officer insists on having the final say on a judgment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Copper' suggests a policeman; it is the metal.
explanation.definitionFit: Shrewdness and good sense in judging situations is a synonym for sound judgment.

clue.text: Wretched bishop's disclosure

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for bishop in chess notation
a leak is an unauthorised disclosure

explanation.surface: A bishop's revelation is miserable.
explanation.definitionFit: A grim, cheerless and hopeless state is miserable, like a wretched one.

clue.text: Dicky left everyone to drop without rescue

indicators.note: dicky is British slang for unsound or shaky, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: all means everyone

explanation.surface: Dicky leaves everyone to fall with no help.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dicky' looks like a name; it is British slang for shaky and signals an anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: Allowing something to fall without catching it is the phrasal verb for dropping.

clue.text: A penny included in rent for shower

indicators.note: one piece is included inside the letters of the other

parts.note: a rent is a tear or cut, a slash
a penny is written P in British money

explanation.surface: Someone notes that a penny has been added to what they pay in rent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rent' looks like money paid for housing, but here it is a tear.
explanation.definitionFit: A light spray of water thrown over someone soaks them like a brief downpour does.

clue.text: Prince and his queen play around

parts.note: Phil is short for Philip, as in Prince Philip
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: A prince and his queen enjoy some recreation.
explanation.definitionFit: To womanise or have casual affairs is to fool or flirt around.

clue.text: One agreeing to make fool join

parts.note: an ass is a fool
to enter a competition or society is to join it

explanation.surface: A person who consents to letting a fool join in.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who assents to a proposal is a person who agrees to it.

clue.text: Unable to manage he spells badly

indicators.note: something spelt badly has its letters jumbled

explanation.surface: He has poor spelling and can't cope.
explanation.definitionFit: Being powerless or lacking strength means one cannot cope without help.

clue.text: Obstruction to appear in road? You can bet on it!

indicators.note: one piece is made to appear inside the other

parts.note: a route is a road or way
in tennis a let is an obstruction calling for a replay; also the old legal phrase 'without let or hindrance'

explanation.surface: A blockage turns up on the highway, and that is a safe bet.
explanation.definitionFit: This casino wheel game is played entirely by placing wagers on where a ball will land.

clue.text: Girl with a Latin prayer book

parts.note: a miss is a girl or young woman

explanation.surface: A girl carries a Latin book of prayers.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the book containing the texts used for celebrating Mass in the Catholic church.

clue.text: Illicit drugs found in storage area

indicators.note: the letters are found inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: Illegal drugs are discovered in a warehouse.
explanation.definitionFit: This is British slang for illegal drugs, especially heroin or cannabis.

clue.text: Stop partner signalling end of engagement on board

definitions.text: signalling end of engagement on board

parts.note: to check something is to stop or halt it
a mate is a partner or companion

explanation.surface: A partner is stopped from signalling that an engagement is over, on a ship perhaps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'engagement' suggests a betrothal; the engagement is a battle on a chess board.
explanation.definitionFit: In chess this call ends the game: the king is attacked and cannot escape.

clue.text: Cancel the validity of yearbook that's not first class

indicators.note: the item that is not present is taken out of the other word

parts.note: an annual is a book published once a year
A, as in A1, denotes first class

explanation.surface: Someone wants to void a yearbook that fails to be top quality.
explanation.definitionFit: To declare a marriage or contract void is to cancel its legal validity.

clue.text: Dismiss blackbird?

parts.note: split, the clue word is black (B, as on pencils) plus bird (OWL), which is how the letters of the answer read

explanation.surface: Can a blackbird be sent away?
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that 'blackbird' is to be split into 'black' and 'bird': B is the abbreviation for black and an owl is a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket, a bowler dismisses a batsman by hitting the wicket with the ball.

clue.text: Frank's business providing hospitality for all

parts.note: frank means open, candid
a house is a business firm, as in a fashion house

explanation.surface: Frank's firm makes everyone welcome.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Frank' looks like a man's name; it is the adjective meaning candid.
explanation.definitionFit: Keeping an event where all visitors are welcome means offering hospitality to everyone.

clue.text: Help on with clothing

parts.note: re means on or about, as in a letter heading
dress is clothing

explanation.surface: Someone asks for help in getting their clothes on.
explanation.definitionFit: A remedy or compensation for a wrong is help given to set matters right.

clue.text: Churchman about to cut cost for medical treatment

indicators.note: the churchman's letters go about the others

parts.note: DD, Doctor of Divinity, is a churchman's title
to rip is to tear or cut
a fee is a cost or charge

explanation.surface: A clergyman is about to reduce what is charged for hospital care.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about to' reads as 'on the verge of', but 'about' is the container and 'to cut' is RIP.
explanation.definitionFit: A slow continuous supply of fluid or nutrients into a vein is a method of treating patients.

clue.text: Burglar lashes Tory leader! That's most malicious!

parts.note: a cat burglar is often just a cat
to lash things is to tie them together

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A burglar whips the head of the Conservatives, an act of extreme spite.
explanation.definitionFit: Spiteful remarks are called catty, and this is the superlative form.

clue.text: Romeo earned beaten backside

parts.note: Romeo is R in the NATO alphabet

indicators.note: letters that are beaten are knocked into a new shape

explanation.surface: Romeo got a beating on his bottom, perhaps deservedly.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for the buttocks; the rear part of a person or vehicle.

clue.text: One second inside current record

indicators.note: the pieces go inside the other

parts.note: DC is direct current
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A single second is contained in an up-to-date record.
explanation.walkthrough: 'current' suggests up to date; here it is electric current.
explanation.definitionFit: A gramophone record is a flat disc of vinyl.

clue.text: Oscar tucked into overcooked fish

indicators.note: one piece is tucked inside the other

parts.note: overcooked food is dry
Oscar is O in the NATO alphabet

explanation.surface: Oscar is eating a fish that has been cooked too long.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tucked into' suggests eating, but it means placed inside.
explanation.definitionFit: The John Dory is an edible sea fish, and the name also covers a flat-bottomed boat.

clue.text: An easing of tension after river engulfs marquee

indicators.note: the river engulfs, so surrounds, the other piece

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Britain
a marquee is a large tent

explanation.surface: Things calm down after a flooding river swallows up a big tent.
explanation.definitionFit: A relaxation of hostility between nations, as during the Cold War, is a lessening of strain.

clue.text: Prevaricator keeps opponents on the straight and narrow

indicators.note: the outer word keeps the other within it

parts.note: a prevaricator is a liar
in bridge, North and East are opponents

explanation.surface: A liar keeps his opponents honest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'straight and narrow' suggests honesty, but it means in a straight line.
explanation.definitionFit: Something arranged in a single straight line is described by this geometric adjective.

clue.text: Slumber for girl holding record

indicators.note: the girl's name holds the other piece

parts.note: Rose is a girl's name
an EP is an extended-play record

explanation.surface: A girl clutching a vinyl disc sleeps.
explanation.definitionFit: Rest or sleep is a state of tranquil slumber.

clue.text: The importance of receiving Tory manifesto

indicators.note: one piece receives the other inside it

parts.note: the pith of something is its essential importance or core
C stands for Conservative, the party of the Tories

explanation.surface: Someone reflects on the significance of getting the Conservative party's manifesto.
explanation.definitionFit: A sales or political pitch is a persuasive statement of one's case, as a manifesto is.

clue.text: Minion finds a bowman in place

indicators.note: one piece goes in the other

parts.note: a site is a place
William Tell, the legendary Swiss archer, is the bowman

explanation.surface: A servant discovers an archer in position.
explanation.definitionFit: A dependent follower or a subservient state is a minion of a more powerful one.

clue.text: Landowner died after retreat

indicators.note: the second piece is placed after the first

parts.note: a lair is a retreat or den
D is the abbreviation for died in genealogies

explanation.surface: A landowner died after withdrawing to a hideaway.
explanation.walkthrough: A laird is a Scottish landed proprietor.
explanation.definitionFit: In Scotland the owner of a large estate is given this title.

clue.text: Girl new to riding shows balance

parts.note: Eve is a girl's name
a jockey who is riding is said to be up

explanation.surface: A girl just starting horse riding displays a good sense of balance.
explanation.definitionFit: To even things up is to make them level, to balance them out.

clue.text: Villain broadcast on the air

indicators.note: broadcast seeds are scattered, so the letters are spread into a new order

explanation.surface: A villain is being broadcast on air.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' and 'on the air' both suggest radio, but 'broadcast' scatters the letters of 'on the air'.
explanation.definitionFit: A protagonist lacking heroic virtues can be a villainous central character.

clue.text: Director eats the stew

indicators.note: one piece eats, so contains, the other

explanation.surface: A film director tucks into a casserole.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stew' looks like the food the director eats; it is the definition, meaning agitation.
explanation.definitionFit: To be in a stew is to be in a state of nervous agitation or indecision.

clue.text: Woman set about Rex after information from cop

indicators.note: the second piece comes after the first

parts.note: gen is British slang for information

indicators.note: one piece is set around the other

parts.note: a dame is a woman
R stands for Rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: A woman attacks the king after a tip-off from a police officer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set about' suggests attacking, but it means placed around.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of the French armed police force is a policeman, so a cop.
